notes: Read the 12-line source file line by line before editing and preserved the ChartGradientBase and memoized ChartGradient exports.
Preserved the id, color, and opacity props, including the web default opacity of 0.3.
Converted the DOM/SVG-only <linearGradient> and two <stop> children into a native-safe inert View marker plus createChartGradientDescriptor metadata for the 0% opacity stop and 95% 0.02 tail stop.
Documented that actual SVG gradient rendering is unavailable in React Native without an SVG chart backend, while avoiding DOM modules, Recharts, Leaflet, and web UI imports.
